decisions.reason: The power-board files are referenced only as an existing production-package model; the source adds deliverables solely to the sensor-board package.
The requested Gerber, drill, pick-and-place, and BOM files do not change board or connector marking requirements.
Requesting a correct sensor-board BOM does not alter component availability, sourcing standards, or fallback requirements.
The source requests manufacturing deliverables and does not change the sensor board's mechanical layout or component placement.
The sensor-board production-package request does not change the board-chain order, power rails, connectors, or distribution behavior.
The source concerns sensor-board production files and does not modify any main-board mechanical-layout constraint.
No main-board connector count, type, destination, or architecture is changed by the production-file request.
The source does not change the current-monitor IC, monitored rails, channel use, or measurement coverage.
Generating production files from the sensor-board design does not change its connector inventory, pinouts, or topology.
The production-package request does not change sensor logic levels, level-shifter omission, footprints, or future adapter policy.
The requested manufacturing files do not alter the SPS30 SEL connection or required I2C operating mode.
The source neither addresses nor changes any power-board dimensions, orientation, connector placement, or mounting constraints.
